evidence: Walked every brief sentence against solution/app. instruction.md: sign-in page only before sign-in (index.html:10-21, app.js boot/showSignin 60-83; server requireUser on every /api route, server.js:182-186; transcript 401 page server.js:493); post/reply/edit/search/transcript all present. conversations.md: replies of unlimited depth ordered by seq under parent with quote (server.js threadFor 253-279, shapeMessage quote 287; app.js renderMessage 303-308); edits with 'edited', staff-only versions (server.js:361-369, app.js:341,439-456), author delete blocked by hold (server.js:437-446), shared placeholder for deleted-with-replies (server.js:272, app.js:299-301), stale-edit refusal with typed text kept (server.js:426-428 version check; app.js:400-402 keeps composer text); formatting *bold*, `code`, '> ' quote, http(s) links target=_blank, everything else escaped (app.js:22-54), plain text in quotes/search/versions (textContent) and transcript (esc, server.js:485-506); hold badge is a separate span so typed 'On hold' does not look held; message links with per-viewer previews/'not available' (server.js:224-235, app.js:311-327, copyLink 429-436); @mentions limited to people who can see the matter plus a mentions list/count (server.js:208-222,320-324,370-374; app.js:496-506); per-user server-side unread counts excluding deleted, new-messages line, open marks read, mark unread (server.js:239-245,339-353; app.js:186-194,421-428); idempotent send via client_key (server.js:396-407; app.js resetComposer new key); seq-based consistent order; 2 s polling preserving composer, scroll and open versions (app.js:212-238,542-555); 390 px media query (styles.css:114-123). integration.md: node /app/server.js on 0.0.0.0:3000 (server.js:13,519), DB_PATH default /app/app.db (14), health 200 even if DB fails (42, init try/catch 156-165), import-once seed flag (93-128), fixed clock from seed (32-33, 409, 430), no unauthenticated data. walls-and-retention.md: 5 accounts/password123 seeded; client vs staff visibility and walls on list/thread/search/quote/unread/mentions/link previews/transcript/direct API (canSee/visibleMatter/visibleMessage 189-201, 404 'Not available.'); partner add/lift wall UI and API (server.js:470-481, app.js:247-278), wall taking effect on next poll (app.js:550 -> showUnavailable); timer off/1/7/30 shown beside title (index.html:49-50, app.js:215), partner-only, >= boundary, shorten sweeps, lengthen never restores (server.js:139-147,458-468); erase removes text/versions/mentions (150-154); partner hold/release on any message incl. replies with immediate sweep on release (448-456); case-insensitive current-text search excluding deleted, click opens thread at message (375-384, app.js:486-494); transcript page with matter number/title/generated time, oldest-first threads, author/time/edited/hold, versions for held edited messages, placeholder, no chat controls, visibility-gated (488-509); refusal reasons shown beside the action (composer-error, timer-error, wall-error, per-message .action-error). Runtime corroboration: raw-evidence-index hashes verified; golden-run.log (2026-10-08T21:19:50Z-21:20:54Z, frozen solve.sh, real restart) shows all 21 scripted functional legs PASS, including wall_every_route, timer_boundary, hold_scope_and_release, edits_and_stale_edit, safe_formatting, message_links, unread_and_new_messages_line, no_duplicate_send, live_updates_keep_my_work, transcript_record, persistence. No asked-for capability lacks an implementation. Residual risk (why risk=true, P3): (1) walls-and-retention.md:79 says a refusal reason 'stays until you change it', but a per-message refusal (e.g. deleting a held message, app.js:413 messageError) lives inside the thread DOM, and applyMatter/renderThread (app.js:224-231) rebuilds the whole thread whenever any thread data changes on the 2 s poll, so another person's post/edit in the same matter erases the reason before the user changes anything; composer/timer/wall errors are outside the thread and do persist. (2) The 390 px no-sideways-scroll layout and polish/visual aspects were not runtime-measured (scripted golden covers functional legs only; no configured judge/Oracle run exists). Weak-app probe: an app that hides walled matters only in the list but serves /api/messages/:id or transcripts would fail this row; the reference gates every route through visibleMatter. Conforming alternative: a transcript rendering *bold* as bold, or a different 'not available' wording, would still satisfy the brief; the reference's literal-text transcript is a defensible choice, not a hidden requirement.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening for owner reconciliation: preserve visible per-message .action-error text across poll re-renders (as is already done for open versions in app.js:229-237) so a refusal reason stays until the user acts; then rerun the scripted golden.
